final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, execution_count, 1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.execution_count) AS sum_counts, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - overall.avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN overall WHERE s.share > overall.avg_share
